entries.title: Psalms 49:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world;

entries.title: Psalms 49:2
segments: both sons of mankind, and sons of man, rich and poor together;

entries.title: Psalms 49:3
segments: my mouth shall speak of wise things; and the thoughts of my heart [shall be] of understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 49:4
segments: I will bow down my ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying on the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 49:5
segments: Why should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the perversity of my ambushers will surround me?

entries.title: Psalms 49:6
segments: Those who trust in their wealth, and their many riches, boast themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 49:7
segments: A man cannot at all redeem a brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,

entries.title: Psalms 49:8
segments: for the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceases forever,

entries.title: Psalms 49:9
segments: yea, he shall yet live forever; he shall never see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 49:10
segments: For he sees wise men die; likewise the fool and the animal-like ones perish, and leave their wealth to others.

entries.title: Psalms 49:11
segments: Their inward [thought is that] their houses shall [go on] forever, and their dwelling-places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names.

entries.title: Psalms 49:12
segments: But man, though high in honor, does not remain; he is like the animals [that] perish.

entries.title: Psalms 49:13
segments: This way of theirs [is] their foolishness; yet their followers delight in their sayings. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 49:14
segments: Like sheep they are appointed to the grave; death shall reign [for] them; and the upright shall have the rule over them in the morning; and their form [is] for rotting; the grave [is] their home.

entries.title: Psalms 49:15
segments: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of the grave; for He will take me. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 49:16
segments: Be not afraid when one becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases;

entries.title: Psalms 49:17
segments: for when he dies he shall take nothing away; his glory shall not go down after him.

entries.title: Psalms 49:18
segments: For in his life he blessed his soul; yea, they praise you when you do well to yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 49:19
segments: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

entries.title: Psalms 49:20
segments: Man in honor, but without understanding, is like the animals; they shall perish.
